items.title: OpenAI Says Hundreds of Thousands of ChatGPT Users May Show Signs of Manic or Psychotic Crisis Every Week
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI released initial estimates about the share of users who may be experiencing symptoms like delusional thinking, mania, or suicidal ideation, and says it has tweaked GPT-5 to respond more effectively.

title_i18n.en: OpenAI Says Hundreds of Thousands of ChatGPT Users May Show Signs of Manic or Psychotic Crisis Every Week
title_i18n.zh: OpenAI表示，每周可能有数十万ChatGPT用户显现躁狂或精神错乱的迹象。
title_i18n.es: OpenAI afirma que cientos de miles de usuarios de ChatGPT pueden mostrar signos de crisis maníaca o psicótica cada semana.

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI released initial estimates about the share of users who may be experiencing symptoms like delusional thinking, mania, or suicidal ideation, and says it has tweaked GPT-5 to respond more effectively.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI公布了初步估计，指出部分用户可能经历妄想思维、躁狂或自杀意念等症状，并已对GPT-5进行调整以更有效地应对这些情况。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI publicó estimaciones iniciales sobre el porcentaje de usuarios que podrían experimentar síntomas como pensamientos delirantes, manía o ideas suicidas, y afirma que ha ajustado GPT-5 para responder de manera más eficaz.

items.title: Show HN: Erdos – open-source, AI data science IDE
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN! We’re Jorge and Will from Lotas ( https://www.lotas.ai/ ), and we’ve built Erdos, a secure AI-powered data science IDE that’s fully open source ( https://www.lotas.ai/erdos ). A few months ago, we shared Rao, an AI coding assistant for RStudio ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44638510 ). We built Rao to bring the Cursor-like experience to RStudio users. Now we want to take the next step and deliver a tool for the entire data science community that handles Python, R, SQL, and Julia workflows. Erdos is a fork of VS Code designed for data science. It includes: - An AI that can search, read, and write across all file types for Python, R, SQL, and Julia.
